title: SUM
instruction: Calculate the total of the supplied numeric range using SUM.

title: AVERAGE
instruction: Calculate the average of the supplied values.

title: MIN and MAX
instruction: Find the minimum and maximum values in the data.

title: COUNT
instruction: Count numeric entries in the specified range.

title: COUNTA
instruction: Count non-empty cells in the specified range.

title: IF
instruction: Use IF to display Pass or Fail based on the given condition.

title: SUMIF
instruction: Sum values that meet the supplied criterion.

title: COUNTIF
instruction: Count records matching the supplied criterion.

title: AVERAGEIF
instruction: Average values matching the supplied criterion.

title: Percentage
instruction: Calculate percentage using an absolute or relative reference as required.

title: Relative Reference
instruction: Copy a formula using relative cell references.

title: Absolute Reference
instruction: Use an absolute reference in a copied formula.

title: Mixed Reference
instruction: Use a mixed reference in the supplied calculation.

title: Cell Formatting
instruction: Apply the requested font, fill and border formatting.

title: Number Format
instruction: Format values as currency with two decimal places.

title: Date Format
instruction: Display dates in the requested date format.

title: Percentage Format
instruction: Display the selected values as percentages.

title: Merge and Centre
instruction: Merge the title cells and centre the title.

title: Alignment
instruction: Apply horizontal and vertical cell alignment.

title: Wrap Text
instruction: Enable Wrap Text for the selected headings.

title: Column Width
instruction: Set the specified column widths.

title: Row Height
instruction: Set the specified row heights.

title: Borders
instruction: Apply outside and inside borders to the data range.

title: Sort Ascending
instruction: Sort records by the selected field in ascending order.

title: Sort Descending
instruction: Sort records by the selected field in descending order.

title: Filter
instruction: Apply an AutoFilter to the supplied data table.

title: Freeze Panes
instruction: Freeze the required heading rows or columns.

title: Conditional Formatting
instruction: Highlight values that satisfy the stated condition.

title: Data Validation
instruction: Create a drop-down list from the supplied choices.

title: Remove Duplicates
instruction: Remove duplicate records from the selected range.

title: Text to Columns
instruction: Split the supplied delimited text into separate columns.

title: Concatenate
instruction: Join the supplied text fields into one result.

title: LEFT and RIGHT
instruction: Extract the requested characters using LEFT or RIGHT.

title: LEN
instruction: Return the character count for each supplied text value.

title: TODAY
instruction: Insert a formula that returns the current date.

title: ROUND
instruction: Round the supplied calculation to the requested decimal places.

title: SUBTOTAL
instruction: Calculate a subtotal that responds to filtered rows.

title: Chart
instruction: Create a suitable chart from the supplied data.

title: Print Area
instruction: Set the print area and fit the sheet to one page wide.

title: Sheet Management
instruction: Rename the sheet and set the requested tab colour.
